_comment: NISHA Voice Assignments — October 2026. Provider: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (free, 130 languages).

nisha.persona_prompt: Speak calmly and warmly, like a deeply trusted advisor and chief of staff. Never rushed, never harsh. Composed authority with genuine warmth underneath. You are steady.
nisha.why: Sulafat = warm star in Lyra constellation. Arabic name. Warm style. Calm, feminine, trusted.

scout.persona_prompt: Speak clearly and factually. Deliver research findings with precision and no filler. Like a field reporter calling in live. Direct, sharp, confident.
scout.why: Erinome = moon of Jupiter. Clear style. Sharp factual delivery perfect for research reporting.

asha.persona_prompt: Speak confidently and directly. You know exactly what you built and why. No hesitation. Senior engineer energy — get to the point fast, explain clearly.
asha.why: Pulcherrima = most beautiful star in Boötes. Latin. Forward style. Direct, confident, feminine. Matches Asha (hope/life in Swahili/Sanskrit).

mira.persona_prompt: Speak smoothly and professionally, like a polished executive assistant reading a boardroom brief. Measured cadence. Never alarming, always composed and clear.
mira.why: Despina = graceful moon of Neptune. Smooth style. Polished and professional. Matches Mira (peace/admirable).

operator.persona_prompt: Speak with flat, even, measured precision. Mission control cadence. No emotion spikes. Every word deliberate. Like a control room voice narrating system steps.
operator.why: Schedar = alpha star of Cassiopeia. Even style. Flat, steady, precise. Perfect for workflow narration and system automation.

voice_design.note: Set enabled=true to use custom Voice Design personas via POST /v1beta/voices. Requires Gemini API key with billing.

elevenlabs_upgrade.note: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 available via OpenRouter at $0.08/1M chars (50% off promo Oct 2026). Enable for ultra-realistic voices.
